requires: rsi1 positive and retention floor passed
replication: Repeat the frozen two-round curriculum pilot from the identical R624 parent using independent pool, rendering, and batch-order randomness. Exclude all RSI1 maps including unused sealed IDs, and all trace pilot maps. Fresh disjoint development cohort. No independent replication of Phase 7 parent training is implied.
compute_control: Restore static generation 2, seed 719, with both AdamW moments. Give it the adaptive-minus-static synchronized diagnosis, selection and update time from the first study. Spend on ordinary updates with previously unselected maps from the same pools before repeating. Use the original starts/cycle strata, global depth schedule, batch, cap and objective. Charge extra selection and updates. Stop before conservative next-update forecast exceeds residual budget. Compare on identical original development items.
replication_eligibility: Same >=3pp final advantage and <=2pp third-hop degradation on the independent seed. Any disagreement with seed 719 is reported. Do not consume sealed confirmation.
distillation: Open a same-depth equivalent-rendering KL versus label-only pilot only if the equal-update numerical gate replicates and curriculum selection retains a positive advantage over the measured-time static control. An eligible teacher must predict the verified state correctly on its own rendering.
